name: mi-ripple
title_zh: AI 图上的网格、鳞片、蜂窝纹，先诊断再修
tagline_zh: 图生图迭代五六轮后，画面浮出一层细密网格或鱼鳞纹，放大看像被压过 JPEG。它先判断是解码器栅格、蜂窝还是颗粒。
tagline_en: After several img2img passes, a fine grid or fish-scale texture creeps in. It first identifies decoder grid.
desc_en: Diagnose and restore grid-like, granular, scale-like, tiled, or ripple artifacts in AI-generated images. Use when a user asks to remove digital ripple, decoder grids, repeating scales, honeycomb texture, granular AI texture, or degradation caused by iterative image-to-image editing.
why_zh: 先分型再动手：栅格、鳞片、蜂窝、颗粒各有各的成因，用错方法只会把纹理抹成塑料。
why_en: Classifies the artifact type first — grid, scale, honeycomb, or grain each need a different fix; the wrong one turns texture.
limit_zh: 只处理 AI 生成或迭代图生图带来的规律性纹理；真实照片的传感器噪点、扫描网纹、印刷摩尔纹不在范围内。
limit_en: Only handles periodic artifacts from AI generation or iterative img2img. Real-photo sensor noise, scan lines, and print moiré are out of scope and.
title_en: Diagnose and remove grid, scale, and honeycomb artifacts.
